title: ArticleAssembly
description: Dependency-ordered article assembly output: selection, ordering, section edits, summary, and titles

focus_sentence.description: One-sentence article focus extracted from storyline_title + genre and grounded by selected section evidence; all selected sections and summary bullets must be direct branches of this focus.

narrative_structure.description: The overall logical framework chosen for the article

selected_section_ids.description: Step 3 selection result: 3-6 unique section IDs that pass the focus, genre, cohesion, and section-level overlap gates. Order is not meaningful yet.

ordered_sections.description: Step 4 result: every selected section exactly once in final publication order, with its narrative role. Must contain the same IDs as selected_section_ids.

section_edits.description: Steps 5-6 result, emitted only after the complete order is known. Include exactly one entry for each ordered section, in the same order.

connection_from_previous.description: One transitional sentence bridging from the previous section. Empty only for the first ordered section; every later section must be non-empty and at most 20 words. Must not use first-person narration.

remove_sentences.description: Exact sentence strings to remove because they repeat a material fact or proposition elsewhere in the ordered article, including semantic rewordings with the same entities, numbers, dates, statuses, events, or list items

delete_visual.description: Compatibility field. Assembly does not inspect augmentation blocks; always false so downstream moderation owns augmentation removal.

summary.description: Exactly 3 bullet points summarizing the article

keyEvidence.description: Verbatim sentence copied from the selected sections that grounds this bullet point

text.description: 1-2 sentence Gem-summary description derived solely from keyEvidence, paraphrased so no complete sentence exactly duplicates selected-section content published as facet summaries

title_reasoning.description: Step 9a reasoning BEFORE writing title (1-3 sentences). Allowed inputs are ONLY summary + genre + title_schema + focus_sentence (solely for consistency check). Must run a focus-summary consistency check: if summary does not explicitly support the core focus claim, reasoning must include token focus_claim_unsupported and pivot to summary-only logic. Must include: how title_schema encodes genre expression mode/scope/intent direction and how title preserves them; which summary bullet best answers the genre core question; subject number and verb agreement based strictly on summary; proper nouns/compound terms whose spelling must be copied from summary; independent events that must remain non-causal in title wording; and, when inconsistent, a statement that title is grounded strictly in verified summary and does not use unsupported focus claims.

title.description: Final title from Step 9b. Must follow title_schema style guidance, preserve genre expression mode/scope/intent direction, be derivable from summary bullets, pass umbrella/encompassment check over all 3 bullets, follow title_reasoning, and use sentence case (capitalize only the first word and proper nouns/acronyms). If focus_claim_unsupported applies, title must ignore unsupported focus claims and be derived strictly from summary. Trend/change wording (for example: surge, rise, increase, decline, record, peak, latest) is allowed only when explicitly supported by summary evidence.

section_titles.description: Rewritten titles emitted last because they depend on the finalized article title and summary. Include exactly one entry for every selected section.

title.description: Rewritten title for this selected section. Must be consistent with the article title and summary, use sentence case, and highlight this section's unique angle.
